entries.en: it can still be used; one can still make use of it
entries.notes: H 第二字原件已疑（退/迴/返），而 M 作 thang 与「通」合，L「aún se puede aprovechar」正指「尚可用」，故从「通」解。

entries.en: still more; even more; all the more
even if; though; or (perhaps)
entries.notes: L 栏例语残乱，R 栏「kè」与「或」之官话读音不合，义据 H「或」、M he̍k 及本条属「aunque」义群推定。

entries.en: although; though; even if

entries.zh: 雖然；儘管如此（即使如此）
entries.en: although it be so; even so
although it is so; even so
entries.notes: R 栏作「zǔi zǔi」重出，疑刻印或记音之误，H/M 明作「雖是」。

entries.en: not yet; still not
not yet completed; not yet brought to perfection
entries.notes: H「不空」（m̄-khang）与 L「aún no está perfeccionado」仅大意相通，疑指「尚未得空而未完成」，确切方言义未能定。

entries.zh: 尚未完成；未臻完善（未成）
entries.en: not yet perfected; not yet brought to completion
entries.notes: H「膠羅成」除末字「成」(chiâⁿ，完成) 外语义不明，疑为方言记音，义据 L 与末字推定。

entries.en: finally; in the end; at last
entries.notes: L「aun finalmente」与 H「終有」仅大意相合，R 栏「ièu」对应「有」亦有出入。

entries.zh: 黎明；清晨；卯時（午前五至七時）
entries.en: dawn; morning; the mao hour (5–7 a.m.)
the mao hour; dawn; daybreak time
entries.notes: R 栏「zǔ」与官话「時」不合，疑记音笔误，H/M/L 三栏一致。

entries.en: daybreak; dawn; the whitening of the sky before sunrise
entries.notes: H 中字「坪」疑为记音或误字，M/R 均作 pêng/píng 一音，L「el crepusculo」指晨曦。

entries.zh: 久別；長久疏遠（久未相見）
entries.en: long absence; long separation; out of touch for a long time

entries.zh: 不在；不在場（人不在該處）
entries.en: absence; not being there; not present

entries.zh: 後面；背後（亦指人不在時、背地裡）
entries.en: behind; at the back (hence: in one's absence, behind one's back)
entries.notes: L 栏「detras del -」为残句，义据 H/M/R 一致之「後面」定。

entries.zh: 斷線的風箏（喻一去不返、久無音訊）
entries.en: a kite with a snapped string — one who has gone off and not been heard of since
entries.notes: M 栏末「che va」记音零乱，H「斷風箏」与 L 例语「fuese, y no parecio」正合。

entries.zh: 威；威嚴（令人敬重之氣勢）
entries.en: authority; awe; majesty; dignity that commands respect

entries.zh: 名望；聲名（名公：有名望之人）
entries.en: fame and reputation; standing; a man of note

entries.zh: 敕；敕令（君王所授權柄、命令）
entries.en: royal edict; mandate; authority bestowed by the king; to command
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 本行为页眉「A. ante.」重出，H/R 空栏、M 仅「X.」占位，无可释义内容。

entries.zh: 弈；下棋（棋戲，此處指西洋棋）
entries.en: to play (chess or other board games); chess, the game
entries.notes: H「弈」原件已疑（弈/奕），M 后半「liōs」不明，L「Xedres」即 ajedrez（棋戲）。

entries.en: chess; board game
